w10_T4_004321: Priya had 33 marbles in her collection. Her cousin Dev had 20 fewer marbles than Priya. At a weekend tournament Dev won 15 more marbles, and the tournament lasted 4 hours. In the school marble league every marble a player owns is worth 8 points. Because it was finals week, the league tripled each player's points. How many league points did Dev end up with?
w10_T4_004322: A groundskeeper is laying rope along the edge of a running track. He starts with a piece of rope 157 yards long, then joins on a second piece of 74 yards and a short piece of 4 yards. A dozen volunteers came to help him carry it. The rope cost 60 dollars per roll. Since every yard is 3 feet, he records the total length in feet, and then tacks on an extra 42 feet of rope to tie off the ends. How many feet of rope does he use in total?
w10_T4_004324: Each of the bakery's 2 ovens turned out 25 loaves this morning. A neighbour dropped off 3 loaves she had baked at home for the bake sale, and a delivery van brought 35 more loaves from the sister shop across town. The van's trip took 40 minutes. By closing time 8 loaves had been thrown out because they were burnt. How many loaves were left?
w10_T4_004325: At the arcade Lena had 212 tokens. Her brother Marco had 8 times as many tokens as Lena. Marco then won 66 more tokens on the claw machine. The arcade is 6 miles from their house. At the prize booth every token Marco held was exchanged for 8 tickets, and afterwards he found 57 loose tickets on the floor and kept them. How many tickets did Marco have at the end?
w10_T4_004326: A community garden started the season with 145 tomato seedlings. Nadia planted 66 more seedlings and Tariq planted 55, so Nadia planted more than Tariq. The garden is 30 metres long. Every seedling grew into a plant that produced 8 tomatoes, and a neighbour also gave the gardeners 71 tomatoes from her own vines. At the market every tomato the garden had was sold for 5 cents. How many cents did the garden take in?
w10_T4_004333: In the morning Amir picked 150 apples and divided them equally into 3 baskets, keeping 1 basket for himself. His sister Bela had 6 times as many apples in her cart as Amir had in his basket. In the afternoon Bela sold every apple in her cart for 7 cents each. In the evening she found 46 more cents in her apron pocket and added them to her takings. How many cents did Bela have in the evening?
w10_T4_004336: Kofi's phone had 133 photos on it. He deleted 17 blurry shots, then 35 duplicates, and then 62 old screenshots. The two friends went to a concert together, where Kofi took 65 new photos, and afterwards Ama sent him 36 photos she had taken that night. When they compared their phones, Ama had 6 times as many photos as Kofi. How many photos did Ama have?
w10_T4_004339: The little theatre has 5 rows of 50 seats each. Before opening night 42 seats were found to be broken and removed, but the staff brought in 72 folding chairs to use as extra seats. Every seat was filled at each of the 7 sold-out performances. Each performance lasted 120 minutes, which the programme lists as two hours. The theatre is 40 years old. After the run, 252 tickets were refunded because of a billing error, and 15 extra standing tickets were sold at the door. How many paid tickets did the theatre end up with?
w10_T4_004340: In the morning Sam started selling from a roll of 152 raffle tickets, and by noon he had sold 131 of them. In the afternoon 15 tickets got wet and were thrown away, and 3 more were torn. The organiser then let him swap each remaining ticket for 2 new ones, and gave him 44 loose tickets as well. In the evening Sam sold every ticket he had for 5 dollars each. How many dollars did Sam collect in the evening?
w10_T4_004344: Marta laid 80 square yards of turf in her back garden and then another 15 square yards along the side. Since each square yard is 9 square feet, she measured the lawn in square feet for the invoice. A section of 753 square feet was later dug up to make a pond. Her neighbour Luis laid 6 times as much lawn as Marta had left. Luis then split his lawn into 2 equal parts and turned one part into a vegetable patch. How many square feet is the vegetable patch?
w10_T4_004346: In the morning the school's lost-and-found bin held 84 items. During morning break 68 more items were dropped in. At lunchtime 52 items were added, and 21 more were added during the afternoon. In the evening, at the parents' meeting, 165 items were claimed by their owners. How many items were in the bin at the end of the evening?
w10_T4_004347: In the morning a quiz team had 191 points on the scoreboard. They lost 15 points for a late answer, and in the afternoon round they lost 140 points on a challenge they got wrong. The whole quiz ran for a single day. In the evening finale each remaining point was exchanged for 4 tokens, and each token could be traded for 5 raffle tickets. How many raffle tickets did the team receive?
w10_T4_004350: A crew building a fence around a paddock laid 87 feet of fence in the first week. The foreman keeps his log in yards, and since every 3 feet make one yard, he wrote that week's length down in yards. The crew laid exactly the same length in each of the 7 weeks of the job. When the job was done the owner asked for the total in feet, so the foreman turned the yards back into feet. A storm then flattened 527 feet of the fence, and another 55 feet were taken down to fit a gate. How many feet of fence were left standing?
w10_T4_004351: A print shop ran off 162 flyers on each of its 2 machines for the street fair. The manager added 61 flyers left over from last week's batch. The fair ran for 6 hours. Volunteers handed out 358 flyers during the fair, and 26 flyers were ruined by rain. How many flyers were left?
w10_T4_004358: A small-town library kept 161 titles in its local-history collection. A retired teacher donated 22 more titles, an estate sale added 73 titles, and a grant paid for 78 more. The library then decided to hold 8 copies of every title in the collection. How many copies of local-history books did the library hold?
w10_T4_004359: On Monday Ben counted 207 six-packs of soda in the shop's storeroom. On Tuesday his partner Dana brought in 79 more six-packs, and on Wednesday Ben brought in 64, so Dana had added more than Ben. Since every six-pack holds 6 cans, they switched to counting the stock in cans. Then they realised the count covered only 1 of the shop's 2 identical storerooms, and the other held exactly the same stock. Over the festival weekend the shop sold 1267 cans. How many cans were left in stock?
w10_T4_004360: In the morning Ana brought 40 raffle tickets to the school fair, and her friend Ben brought 2 times as many tickets as Ana. Ben divided his tickets equally among 4 sellers, and Ana took one seller's batch to the gate. In the afternoon she sold every ticket in her batch for 5 dollars each, then refunded 57 dollars to a customer who had bought by mistake. The fair ran for 6 days, and Ana took in exactly that same amount every day. On the evening of the last day Ana and Ben shared her total takings equally between the 2 of them. How many dollars did Ana receive?
w10_T4_004365: In the morning a parking garage had 162 cars in it. By mid-morning 33 more cars had arrived, and another 51 arrived during the afternoon. In the late afternoon 110 cars drove out. In the evening 93 more cars left. How many cars were in the garage at the end of the evening?
w10_T4_004370: Eli put 117 coins into his savings jar in each of 3 months, which was more than his sister Faye managed to save. He then found 18 coins under the sofa and added them to the jar. Later he took 61 coins out to buy a comic. His parents then ran a matching scheme that left him with 2 coins in the jar for every coin he had. How many coins were in Eli's jar after the matching scheme?
w10_T4_004371: A farm pressed 220 pints of cider and shared it equally between its 2 market stands. At Nora's stand 56 pints were spilled when a barrel tipped over. Nora serves cider by the cup, and since each pint fills 2 cups, she works out how many cups she has. Each cup sells for 3 dollars. A neighbouring stand then gave her 37 more cups of cider. How many cups of cider does Nora have to sell?
w10_T4_004377: A dairy co-op had 145 quarts of milk, and Ola brought in 5 more quarts. Since a quart is 4 cups, the co-op measured the milk in cups. The cups were shared equally among 4 families, and Ola's family was one of them. Ola's family later received 36 more cups from a neighbour, then used 128 cups on a single cheese-making day. Pat's family used up its whole share, so Ola's family ended with more milk than Pat's. How many cups of milk did Ola's family have left?
w10_T4_004384: In the morning a bakery had 189 bread rolls on the shelf, and the baker added 6 more from the oven. By noon 119 rolls had been sold. In the afternoon the baker cut each remaining roll into 3 slices for the sandwich counter. In the evening rush 179 slices were sold. How many slices were left at the end of the evening?
w10_T4_004386: A bakery signed a contract to deliver bread to a hotel for 134 weeks. The hotel cancelled 43 of those weeks, then later extended the contract by 6 weeks. The bakery's scheduler counts in days rather than weeks, and since a week has 7 days, she wrote the contract length down in days. Each delivery van carries 500 loaves. So far 648 delivery days have been completed, 28 delivery days fall on public holidays with no delivery, and 2 days were lost to a snowstorm. How many delivery days remain?
w10_T4_004390: Ruth marked out a 130-yard walking trail through the woods. She shortened it by 30 yards to avoid a stream, then added a 69-yard loop and a 62-yard spur to a lookout. Her brother Sam's trail was shorter than Ruth's. Since a yard is 3 feet, Ruth measured her trail in feet for the trailhead sign. She then added a 69-foot boardwalk at the end. How many feet long was Ruth's trail?
w10_T4_004392: Vic's corner shop had 127 six-packs of juice, but sold 118 of them over the holiday weekend. Since a six-pack holds 6 cans, Vic counted what was left in cans. His rival Wen, whose shop is across the street, had 6 times as many cans of juice as Vic. Wen then received a delivery of 76 more cans. How many cans of juice did Wen have?
